subject.title: TUI: Support Shift+Enter for newline (Enter to send)

question: Should the remaining TUI work be docs/help for the existing pi-tui newline behavior, or should OpenClaw expose a supported configurable send/newline keybinding surface for openclaw tui?
rationale: Current main already supports newline insertion through pi-tui, but a user-configurable preference would add public TUI config or CLI surface under a repository policy that sets a high bar for new config.

options.title: Document Current Behavior
options.body: Document Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, terminal limitations, and backslash-Enter fallback while keeping Enter-to-send fixed.

options.title: Add TUI Keybinding Preference
options.body: Define a narrow config or CLI surface for send/newline keybindings with default compatibility, docs, and focused tests.

recommendation.title: Document Current Behavior
recommendation.body: Document Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, terminal limitations, and backslash-Enter fallback while keeping Enter-to-send fixed.

likelyOwner.reason: They already reviewed this exact issue and have the strongest current TUI wrapper/docs history signal.
